title: Cache namespace collapses to "__dynamic__" for non-function callables, so different graphs sharing a cache return each other's results
observed_behavior: Two graphs each have a node named 'process', implemented as callable objects and sharing one InMemoryCache. The first graph stores 'from graph A'; the second graph returns 'from graph A' and its node never runs, because both nodes hash to the same cache namespace '__dynamic__'.
structure_focus: Graph-level cache sharing across separate compiled graphs; node identity in cache namespace
notes: Open, label external. The fixture keeps the two build() calls sharing one cache and the callable-object nodes; a named-function control in the issue shows the collision is specific to the identifier() fallback for callables without __qualname__/__module__ (also functools.partial). Root cause is cache key construction in pregel/_algo.py (namespace carries no graph identity); comments discuss wrapper/closure/bound-method controls and an execution-identity framing.
